invariants: Answer permission is asker or current recorded parent of asker; root question visibility may fall back to current prime without granting new answer authority.
Live decisions/anomalies and parent filters project the current recorded parent; decision.opened preserves parent-at-ask. Reads never rewrite the durable question or invent a second parent field.

Question creation commits decision row plus decision.opened first, atomically, with question_seq equal to the allocated event seq. Retain report.question semantic publication afterward outside the bus lock; second-step failure explicitly names the durable decision rather than losing it.
For another seat answer, persist answer/outbound linkage before delivering through existing DeliveryService to asked_by; do not route to parent instead. Use stable answer_msg_id.

Non-self answer closes only after durable delivery acceptance; rejection leaves an inspectable open decision/refusal. Self-answer closes with resolved answerer and decision.answered, answer_msg_id=null, and no redundant push. The existing /v1/send self-send refusal remains unchanged.
Repeated identical answer must not duplicate push; conflicting answer on an answered row refuses. No custom retries or new transport.
Only the current recorded parent may use answer --supersede <decision> <answer> (typed supersede=true); the asker, former parent and unrelated seats cannot supersede.
Supersede is restricted to a terminal non-delivered answer: failed/no-queue prepared intent or an already-recorded terminal expired-unknown outcome. Never use elapsed time to infer expiry.

An answer in transit cannot be withdrawn; wait for its terminal outcome. Pending/running jobs and direct-delivery reservations refuse E-RS-ANSWER-IN-TRANSIT with old answer_msg_id and job_state; delivered/acked answers refuse E-RS-ANSWER-DELIVERED.
Existing delivery claim expiry returns to pending, not terminal expired-unknown, and therefore remains refused. No queue cancellation, withdrawal, new transport, or custom retry is introduced.

The decision.answer-superseded event and fresh open prepared row commit atomically. The event retains the old answer_msg_id, answered_by and answer under superseded. A new answer_msg_id derives from the actual allocated supersession event seq, never MAX/COUNT guesses.
Ordinary identical retry uses the newly persisted answer_msg_id. Final closure verifies that exact msg id; an obsolete completion cannot close the replacement answer.

Delivery proof includes durable delivery.outcome history and done queue rows after bounded delivered-id eviction. A surviving pre-injection reservation with no completed audit is conservatively in transit.

DeliveryOutcome::Refused is terminal (core/model.rs); its completed audit permits explicit replacement even if the old pre-injection marker remains. DeliveryOutcome::Held is pending and vetoes supersede even after marker eviction. Every replacement still passes ordinary DeliveryService acceptance and may itself be refused.

Explicit supersede requires queue=real and spine=real with the composition root guaranteeing that queue, decision store and event bus use the same SQLite pool (persistent in production). Adapter labels alone are not proof of shared authority.

After current-parent authorization and before any replacement, mixed/fake backends refuse HTTP409 E-RS-ANSWER-AUTHORITY-SPLIT, naming both queue_backend and spine_backend. They do not append a supersession event, mutate the old decision, cancel old work, or admit a replacement.
Ordinary question, answer, identical retry and self-answer behavior remains available for all supported queue/spine configurations.
Self or recorded parent may tombstone. This operation does not signal a process or kill a tmux pane.
Emit stamped seat.tombstone through the sole event bus; active /v1/seats excludes it. Keep tombstone evidence for history/revive.

Unknown target refuses. A parent repeat-close returns the existing tombstone/event without inventing an incarnation. A retired self retry retains universal identity refusal, with the tombstone seq named in its decodable evidence; no authentication exception.
Decision: known proc dead OR proc_start mismatch, AND recorded pane confirmed absent. Paneless records require only confirmed dead/mismatched proc.
Unknown process or pane evidence is a brake: removing this check reaps the same set or more. Unknown rows are reported unverifiable and never tombstoned.
Never signal a recycled/live process. This is stale-record reconciliation, not process termination or retention policy; no age-based deletion.
Dry-run is entirely read-only including spine; actual run on same observations reports same candidates and before/after counts plus reaped rows/sequences.
Re-observe/validate descriptor identity before tombstoning so a concurrently revived incarnation cannot be removed using stale evidence.

anomaly_rules.threshold_owner: One named constant in crates/core; 30min anomaly threshold is distinct from 10min per-command stderr nudge
anomaly_rules.boundary: Fire only when driftMs > status_stale_ms; equality does not flag
anomaly_rules.evidence: real rs seqs only; never guessed counts or legacy timestamps
anomaly_rules.decision_parent_age: An open decision older than status_stale_ms produces status-stale for its CURRENT responsible parent even when that parent recently reported. Include decision ref; ordinary open-question remains visible. Historical parent-at-ask stays in decision.opened, not the live responsibility projection.
anomaly_rules.verification: A receipt only verifies its referenced done_seq; newer done remains unverified.
